chars.H: HERO: a slim shy young man wearing an oversized mustard-yellow hoodie, light blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.M: MONA: a young woman wearing a bright red leather jacket over a black top, gold hoop earrings, red lipstick mouth and black skinny jeans.
chars.G: THE GIRLS: two young women, one wearing a lime-green tracksuit, the other wearing a lilac oversized shirt and white trousers.
chars.F: FRIEND: a young man wearing a black-and-white striped football jersey and grey shorts.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: On the sandy beach of Ain Diab in Casablanca on a sunny afternoon, a group sits on towels. THE GIRLS lean together, giggling and side-eyeing MONA who sits stiffly with crossed arms and an offended frown; HERO sits between them looking awkward and nervous. Comic, tense mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Beach in Casablanca. THE GIRLS whisper into each other's ears behind their hands, laughing secretly, while MONA in the background turns her head suspiciously toward them.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Beach in Casablanca. THE GIRLS and FRIEND exchange sly looks and one girl discreetly waves her hand in front of her own nose as a joke, while MONA walks past them unaware. Funny awkward moment.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Beach in Casablanca at sunset. MONA stands up angrily, fists clenched, glaring at THE GIRLS who freeze mid-laugh with guilty faces.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A girl's bedroom in a Casablanca apartment at night. MONA sits on her bed furiously typing on her smartphone, angry vengeful expression, lit by the phone screen glow. The screen faces away from the viewer.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A small Casablanca café terrace. MONA leans over a table talking dramatically, telling a story with big gestures, while THE GIRLS and FRIEND listen shocked with open mouths.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A Casablanca street outside a language center. THE GIRLS and FRIEND point accusing fingers at HERO, who raises his hands trying to explain, panicked. They turn their backs on him.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: A Casablanca café. FRIEND holds out his smartphone toward HERO (screen facing HERO, away from the viewer); HERO stares at it in total shock, eyes wide, mouth open, hands on his head.
